about.title: About me
about.description: I’m a passionate  Mobile App Developer with over 2 years of experience creating and launching Succesful  apps. My skills cover full-stack development, including both backend and frontend technologies, as well as mobile platforms. I work with Framework as Node.js, Express, Angular, Flutter, and Android, which allows me to create flexible and scalable solutions tailored to different business needs.
